run_main: run the main function to generate YAML build configuration for bad SSL end-to-end tests
create_testoptions: create a TestOptions namedtuple with flaky and cpu_cost fields for test configuration
review_BAD_CLIENT_TESTS: review the BAD_CLIENT_TESTS dictionary mapping test names to their TestOptions configuration
summarize_main: summarize the main function that generates libs and targets for bad SSL test builds
refactor_BAD_CLIENT_TESTS: refactor the BAD_CLIENT_TESTS dictionary to add or remove SSL test entries with custom cpu_cost
